message: Reflective access to sCursorWindowSize, which is not part of the public SDK and therefore likely to change in future Android releases
impact: Future Android may reject the reflection; existing try/catch prevents startup crash, but large rows could exceed the platform CursorWindow limit.
reason: Startup requests a 32 MiB global cursor window using a private field. A public CursorWindow constructor only sizes an individual cursor; replacing the call would require ownership changes for cursor creation and large-row regression testing.
checks: Inspected DatabaseUtil, RikkaHubApp and SQLiteConfiguration; Room uses the separate requery helper and migrations remain unchanged.
required_conditions: Measure large legacy database rows on target devices and migrate cursor creation to supported per-cursor sizing before removing the compatibility fallback.

message: Consider also using `StorageManager#getAllocatableBytes` and `allocateBytes` which will consider clearable cached data

message: Use the KTX extension function `SharedPreferences.edit` instead?
impact: Style suggestion; synchronous feedback persistence must report a failed commit.
reason: SharedPreferences.edit(commit=true) returns Unit, whereas FeedbackStorage.record must return the actual commit Boolean and clear must check it. The suggested extension would hide write failures.
checks: Inspected FeedbackStorage, FeedbackLedger and durable feedback process regression; keeps commit failure contract.
required_conditions: An extension/API returning the actual commit result, or a separately tested equivalent wrapper that preserves failure reporting.

message: Use "`Gravity.START`" instead of "`Gravity.LEFT`" to ensure correct behavior in right-to-left locales
impact: Explicit physical TextAlign.Left/Right stay physical in RTL locales.

checks: Inspected all six TextAlign branches in setComposeTextStyle; resource direction support is preserved.
required_conditions: Only change if the product contract removes physical alignment; then verify RTL and explicit left/right text.
